headline: Store With A Gap / Studio Cadena
context: Store With A Gap Trades Private Frontage for a Pocket of Public Space in Medellín . Studio Cadena's adaptive reuse project carves into an existing building to extend the sidewalk inward, layering retail, a dance studio, and a café behind a perforated metal screen.
